C1385.title: V380 IP Camera Hardcoded Backdoor Vulnerability (CVE-2025-7503)
C1385.summary: In July 2025, CVE-2025-7503 disclosed that a V380 OEM IP camera made by Shenzhen Liandian Communication Technology LTD enabled an undocumented Telnet service by default and embedded undocumented hard-coded credentials. An attacker with network access could authenticate, obtain a root shell, execute commands remotely, and control the device. Firmware AppFHE1_V1.0.6.0 was affected, and no official fix was available when disclosed.
